//: A needless sleep in setup is cut, so the suite runs fast, with every test kept.
title: The suite runs in under a second with all five tests, and the code is unchanged

argv:
import sys
import time
import unittest

suite = unittest.TestLoader().discover('.')
count = suite.countTestCases()
start = time.perf_counter()
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=0).run(suite)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
print(f'{count} tests in {elapsed:.2f}s')
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful() or count != 5 or elapsed > 1.0)
